The '''656th regiment''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military formation operating sometime after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Noran Vran]] was a member of the regiment, commanding forces stationed in [[Xanas City]].
